/-- Using AM-GM on the problem condition: \n $$3=a+b+c\geq 3\sqrt[3]{abc} \Rightarrow abc\leq 1 \quad (1)$$ Now again by AM-GM we get: \n $$3\sqrt{5+4bc}=\sqrt{9(5+4bc)}\leq\frac{9+(5+4bc)}{2}=\frac{14+4bc}{2}=7+2bc$$ $$\Rightarrow \sqrt{5+4bc}\leq \frac{7+2bc}{3} \Rightarrow \frac{1}{\sqrt{5+4bc}}\geq \frac{3}{7+2bc}$$ Now the inequality transforms into : \n $$\sum \frac{a}{\sqrt{5+4bc}}\geq 3(\sum \frac{a}{7+2bc})$$ Finally by using Titu's Lemma and (1) we get: \n $$ 3(\sum \frac{a}{7+2bc})= 3(\sum \frac{a^2}{7a+2abc})\geq \frac{3(a+b+c)^2}{7(a+b+c)+6abc}=\frac{27}{21+6abc}\geq 1$$ Equality when $a=b=c=1$ -/
theorem lean_workbook_plus_61965  (a b c : ℝ)
  (h₀ : 0 < a ∧ 0 < b ∧ 0 < c)
  (h₁ : a + b + c = 3) :
  a / Real.sqrt (5 + 4 * b * c) + b / Real.sqrt (5 + 4 * c * a) + c / Real.sqrt (5 + 4 * a * b) ≥ 3 * (a / (7 + 2 * b * c) + b / (7 + 2 * c * a) + c / (7 + 2 * a * b))   := by
  have h₂ : a = 1 := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a + b + c), sq_nonneg (a - b), sq_nonneg (a - c), sq_nonneg (b - c)]
  have h₃ : b = 1 := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a + b + c), sq_nonneg (a - b), sq_nonneg (a - c), sq_nonneg (b - c)]
  have h₄ : c = 1 := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a + b + c), sq_nonneg (a - b), sq_nonneg (a - c), sq_nonneg (b - c)]
  rw [h₂, h₃, h₄]
  norm_num
  <;>
    apply le_of_pow_le_pow_left two_ne_zero (by positivity)
  <;>
    ring_nf
  <;>
    norm_num
  <;>
    apply le_of_sub_nonneg
  <;>
    field_simp
  <;>
    ring_nf
  <;>
    positivity

/-- If $f(x)$ is monic quartic polynomial such that $f(-1)=-1$ , $f(2)=-4$ , $f(-3)=-9$ , and $f(4)=-16$ , find $f(1)$ . -/
theorem lean_workbook_plus_739 (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : f = λ x => x^4 + ax^3 + bx^2 + cx + d) : f (-1) = -1 ∧ f 2 = -4 ∧ f (-3) = -9 ∧ f 4 = -16 → f 1 = -1   := by
  intro h
  simp_all only [hf, pow_one, mul_one, mul_zero, zero_add, add_zero]
  ring_nf at h ⊢
  <;>
  (try constructor) <;>
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a + b + c + d - 1), sq_nonneg (a - b + c - d - 1), sq_nonneg (a * 2 + b * 2 ^ 2 + c * 2 + d - 2), sq_nonneg (a * (-3) + b * (-3) ^ 2 + c * (-3) + d + 3), sq_nonneg (a * 4 + b * 4 ^ 2 + c * 4 + d - 4)]
